notes.title: Entropy - Release Delay
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

2021 was not an easy year for anyone, with everything happening in the world, and for Evil Bunneh as a small INDIE game development company it was no different.

Because of a multitude of reasons we have decided to delay the release of Entropy. We would like to let everyone know and address the concerns that the game has been canceled, that is not the case. We are still very much working on the game and have no plan of scrapping this project.

We hope to see changes in 2022 and will be posting new updates to the development progress soon.

Thank you,
Evil Bunneh Team
